# build-module -- a hand-dispatched build of one ref, under (R263)(4).
# Inputs: the ref to build and the lake target. Steps: checkout at the ref; elan from its official install script, the toolchain pinned by
# lean-toolchain; lake exe cache get; a free-memory logger beside the build that stops lake if free memory falls beneath the 2,560 MB hold;
# lake build of the target; a scratch file through lake env lean carrying #print axioms for every named terminal; the build log, the memory log
# and the axioms output uploaded as the run's artifact. No secret is used; the platform's own token alone (read-only contents).
name: build-module

on:
  push: { branches: [rebuild-b721] }
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "the commit SHA or branch to build"
        required: true
      target:
        description: "the lake target to build"
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 300
    env:
      HOLD_MB: "2560"
      TARGET: Kernel Bridge MetaKernel
    steps:
      - name: Checkout at the ref
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - name: Refuse a target outside the lake grammar
        run: |
          case "$TARGET" in
            *[!A-Za-z0-9_.\ ]*|"") echo "target refused: $TARGET"; exit 2 ;;
          esac
          mkdir -p out
          git rev-parse HEAD > out/ref.txt
          cat lean-toolchain >> out/ref.txt

      - name: Install elan (official script; the toolchain from lean-toolchain)
        run: |
          curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh -o elan-init.sh
          sh elan-init.sh -y --default-toolchain none
          echo "$HOME/.elan/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Mathlib cache
        run: lake exe cache get 2>&1 | tail -20 > out/cache.log

      - name: Build under the hold
        run: |
          (
            while true; do
              avail=$(awk '/MemAvailable/ {print int($2/1024)}' /proc/meminfo)
              echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) avail_mb=$avail" >> out/mem.log
              if [ "$avail" -lt "$HOLD_MB" ]; then
                echo "STOP $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) avail_mb=$avail beneath the hold $HOLD_MB" >> out/mem.log
                pkill -f lake || true
                pkill -f lean || true
              fi
              sleep 5
            done
          ) &
          LOGGER=$!
          set +e
          lake build $TARGET > out/build.log 2>&1
          echo "$?" > out/build_exit.txt
          kill "$LOGGER" || true
          awk -F'avail_mb=' '/avail_mb=/ {split($2,a," "); if (min=="" || a[1]+0<min) min=a[1]+0} END {print "LOW " min}' out/mem.log >> out/mem.log
          exit 0

      - name: Axioms of the named terminals
        if: always()
        run: |
          cat > out/Axioms.lean <<'EOF'
          import Bridge.CartanBBridge
          import Bridge.ConservationBridge
          import Bridge.CrossClassExclusion
          import Bridge.TheBridgeComplete
          import Bridge.Voice3_FE
          import Kernel.Cascade.SieveCeiling
          import Kernel.Cascade.SieveCeilingBridge
          import Kernel.Cascade.SieveCeilingSemantic
          import Kernel.Cascade.SieveCeilingWitness
          import Kernel.Core
          import Kernel.Integration
          import Kernel.Layer1
          import Kernel.ProductFormula_Rat
          import Kernel.SilenceTheorem
          import Kernel.SpectralCannonFull
          import Kernel.Voice1
          import Kernel.Voice3b
          import Kernel.Voice7
          import MetaKernel
          #print axioms ConservationBridge.conservation_activates_balance
          #print axioms ConservationBridge.riemann_hypothesis
          #print axioms ConservationBridge.structural_exhaustiveness_proved
          #print axioms ConservationBridge.ConservationHypothesis
          #print axioms SIDEKernel.formation
          #print axioms techne_kernel.SIDE_exclusion
          #print axioms SpectralCannonFull.spectral_cannon
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice1.balance_theorem
          #print axioms SieveCeilingBridge.blind_sieve_ceiling
          #print axioms bright_access_required
          #print axioms c6_exclusion
          #print axioms c7_exclusion
          #print axioms ProductFormula.conservation_of_spectra
          #print axioms SieveCeilingWitness.dh_witness
          #print axioms e_difficulty
          #print axioms CartanBridge.elliptic_regularity_collapse
          #print axioms fe_symmetry
          #print axioms CartanBridge.formation_n_3_eq_two
          #print axioms CartanBridge.identity_theorem_unique_bridge
          #print axioms none_produce
          #print axioms CartanBridge.output_stage_card
          #print axioms proof_dichotomy
          #print axioms ProductFormula.s_darkness_from_product
          #print axioms sieve_ceiling
          #print axioms SieveCeilingSemantic.sieve_ceiling_semantic
          #print axioms SilenceTheorem.silence_universal
          #print axioms techne_kernel_cross_exclusion.all_pairs_excluded
          #print axioms techne_kernel_integration.rh_from_structural_exhaustiveness
          #print axioms techne_kernel_integration.structural_exhaustiveness_iff_rh
          #print axioms techne_kernel_integration.voice3b_certificate
          #print axioms techne_kernel_integration.voice7_certificate
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice3b.codim_off_line
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice3b.codim_on_line
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice3b.cr_forces_half
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice3b.cr_minimal_iff
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice3b.offLine_of_codim_two
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice3b.realConstraint_card
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice3b.reflect_fixed_iff
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice3b.zero_codimension
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice7.topological_constant
          #print axioms techne_kernel_voice7.topological_no_sigma_preference
          #print axioms ECondition.type_I_has_ostrowski
          #print axioms voice7_sigma_neutral
          EOF
          if [ "$(cat out/build_exit.txt)" = "0" ] && ! grep -q '^STOP ' out/mem.log; then
            lake env lean out/Axioms.lean > out/axioms.txt 2>&1 || true
          else
            echo "NOT RUN: the build did not complete under the hold" > out/axioms.txt
          fi

      - name: Upload the run's artifact
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-module-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: out/
          if-no-files-found: error
